title: Transit revenue-vehicle backlog reaches 23.1 percent in FY 2025, above target
summary: DOT reports 23.1 percent of transit revenue vehicles exceeding their useful-life benchmark in FY 2025, compared with a 22.0 percent target. Denominator: Dedicated revenue vehicles reported through the National Transit Database; spare and non-dedicated vehicles are excluded under the stated method.
